international.title: Academy trust pays out after Prevent threat over children’s Palestine badges
international.summary: Lion Academy Trust apologises after threatening four pupils in east London with referral to counter-extremism scheme An academy trust will pay out tens of thousands in compensation to four children who were told they could be referred to Prevent for wearing Palestine flag badges to school. The school, part of Lion Academy Trust, has issued a formal apology after it sent letters to the children’s parents saying they might be referred to the counter-extremism programme or to local hate crime teams.
